title: UTR Summer League 2026 — Gold Division Champions
content:
We won the UTR Summer League Gold division championship, but it was far from easy. Our EDW team finished first in Gold and second in Silver.

The idea behind the team was simple: EDW stands for the initials of the Chinese pronunciation of “2.5.” We wanted to help beginners and remember what it felt like when we first picked up a racket.

Lineups were the biggest headache during the regular season. Most of our men were above UTR 5.5, while our women were either around 2 or above 4. With rating caps for each line, we calculated more than 200 combinations and still could not find a usable lineup. To give everyone a chance to play, we arranged as many challenge matches as possible.

The final started badly. D1 dropped a game early, and we lost the first set on all three other courts. Our D4 women's doubles pair fell behind 0–5 but fought back to 3–6. D3 battled into a super tiebreak and narrowly won. D2 broke serve from a desperate 3–5 position and extended the contest into a replay.

For two days before the replay, teammates watched the match footage repeatedly. Jinjin and Tony arrived an hour early to warm up. The players were nervous, and those waiting off court for the score were even more anxious. Finally, we held serve and won the last game to lift the championship trophy.
